text: This week was flagged due to evidence that CMP2946's browsing behavior is atypical for their role as a Salesman. Specifically, the analyst noticed 7 visits to job-search sites, which is significantly above the average for this user and even more so compared to same-role peers (z=7.0). This unusual activity suggests that CMP2946 may be engaging in job searching or seeking new opportunities outside of their typical role.
